_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for coverage floors (phase 24, Gate 1.3 / Gate 7.3).
Floors move UP only. tools/ci/check-floor-monotonicity.py fails any decrease unless the commit
cites an ADR-NNNN that exists and names the module. tools/ci/raise-floors.py proposes increases
after a green run when measured exceeds a floor by more than 3 points.
aggregates: the two gates enforced since 18.E1. NOT lowered in phase 24 — the sponsor decision was
to keep the bar and fix the measurement (ADR-0027). Domain measures 82.5% against this floor of 58.
target: CLAUDE.md requires >=80% on domain logic. That is where the ratchet is walking to.
modules: seeded 3 points below measured, so ordinary run-to-run variance does not fail a build while
a real regression does. Keys are '<module>:<layer>'. Modules under 40 coverable lines are omitted -

modules: seeded 5 points below a local Debug measurement, because CI measures Release and sequence points differ; the first green CI run is the real baseline and raise-floors.py tightens from there. Keys are '<module>:<layer>'. Modules under 40 coverable lines are omitted - a percentage over a handful of lines swings on noise and ratchets nothing.
